what_happened: Reproduced the git-commit-scoped.sh silent-staging-drop symptom (named positive pathspec absent from a successful exit-0 commit) in a controlled scratch-repo harness: two concurrent invocations naming the same shared path, with the specs/.commit-lock mutex forced into its own documented fail-open path (pre-occupied by a long-lived foreign holder), reproduced the drop in 1/10 and 3/20 trials; a control run with the mutex working normally showed 0/20 drops across two batches. This pins the mechanism to the mutex's fail-open branch plus a genuinely concurrent second writer on the same path, directly falsifying that branch's own in-code safety comment.
